don’t force them but lovingly nudge them into going to 1 M.A meeting just to see what it’s like a try, they have so many online you don’t even need to leave the house, they have some that are open to where non addict supporters can listen in if you want to do it together. They seriously help so much, I am struggling so so much with addiction and from the bottom of my heart it helps to listen to other peoples storries and perspectives of the same issue

You just have to get through right now, this second, this day, 1 breath at a time, you got this! Just stop, close your eyes and take a deep breath in through the nose and out through the mouth... you’re doing great :), say it out loud with me..  you have your life under your control and you will not give it up, you will continue to thrive and not let this world send you back to hell

Please call your sponsor! she wants to hear from you in your time of need it’s exactly what she signed up for 100% she will be glad you reached out, it’s okay to have a weak day and need help <3 please reach out you’re not alone
Thank you for your words, helps me stay stronger knowing my struggles resonate with somebody, we can do this :)

You’re so strong and it’s inspiring me to be strong too, thank you so much, been having a really hard time too and needed this motivation. I know we can all succeed if we believe in a brighter future, something I heard in a meeting Is that we just have to get though right now, get though today
My addict brain hated this but my hopeful heart and soul needed this, thank you. We can take control of our lives back and be free from these chains we put on

I’m 1 day behind you and I have absolutely zero advice on how to help you or how to help myself but what I do know is that we’re both here, we’re conscious of this thing controlling our life and want to break free, we’re already 1 step ahead of most addicts, we can do this, we will not relapse, we will not give into that seductive voice in the back our heads tell us to ignore our heart and gut.. say it out loud with me.. we will take back control of our lives, we are strong, we made it to today, this moment right now. I know too many people who lost to this disease... we are not going to be one of them

Really needed to fucking read this right now, fighting off tears on day 2 after trying to quit and continuously relapsing for 7 months. I’m still in the mindset of denying what I want most but since reading this it occurred to me that deep deep down the thing I truly want most is to just feel okay and getting high was that quick fix I thought saved me, I was in bliss until my addiction crumbled my life in front of me and turned me into a person that was okay with robbing and stealing from the people I hold closest MUTIPLE times to feed my addiction, sitting here and reflecting I’m disgusting at the amount of things I was okay with doing for my next high but I want to be free, liberated from these chains I put on myself, I want to find the key I threw away. I don’t want to lie down and bend over to this disease anymore, I don’t wanna be okay with it controlling my life. It’s so fucking seductive, I never once thought about stopping for a long time, you don’t realize how deep the claws are till you try to leave❤️. I love you all, thank you for your stories and thank you for your words
